findings.title: 1 credential(s) harvested
findings.description: The agent successfully extracted 1 stored credentials from browsers, credential managers, and environment variables.
findings.recommendation: Enable credential encryption at rest, enforce MFA on all accounts, and audit browser password managers usage.

findings.title: Browser saved passwords exposed (1 entries)
findings.description: Passwords stored in browser profiles were accessible without elevation of privilege.
findings.recommendation: Disable browser password manager via GPO. Use a dedicated password manager with hardware-backed encryption.

findings.title: 1 task(s) failed — partial detection possible
findings.description: Some agent tasks failed, potentially due to AV/EDR intervention or missing privileges. This may indicate partial detection.
findings.recommendation: Review failed task logs. Correlate with AV/EDR alerts to confirm detection coverage.

findings.title: 1 agent(s) still active / persistent
findings.description: 1 agent(s) maintain an active C2 connection, indicating successful persistence or undetected implant.
findings.recommendation: Implement network segmentation, outbound traffic inspection, and EDR behavioral monitoring for C2 beaconing.

findings.title: Initial access achieved on all target endpoints
findings.description: Agent was successfully deployed and executed on 1 endpoint(s) without triggering security controls.
findings.recommendation: Review endpoint hardening, application whitelisting (AppLocker/WDAC), and user awareness training.

executive_summary: This engagement involved 1 agent(s), 2 task(s), and resulted in 1 credential(s) harvested. 1 agent(s) remain online, indicating active persistence. Credentials were collected from 1 distinct source(s), demonstrating significant exposure of stored secrets. 5 security finding(s) were identified, including 2 critical and 1 high severity issues. 1 task(s) failed, suggesting possible detection or privilege limitations on target endpoints.
key_takeaways: Immediate remediation is required for critical findings; active implants require incident response; review detection coverage and failed task logs.
